    <div><h2><a href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TSG.2025.3601238">SPTO published in IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid</a></h2><p>SPTO couples probabilistic electricity-cost forecasting with stochastic water-supply scheduling and trains the forecast against downstream decision quality.</p></div>
